theory: The introduction describes shape solely through skewness, whereas the booklet explicitly includes modality. Teach the modality terms needed by the existing items, particularly uniform, unimodal and bimodal, including that separated peaks need not have equal heights. Qualify the claim that tall columns on the left necessarily imply positive skew, since multiple peaks can invalidate that shortcut. Two matching peaks alone do not establish symmetry; the whole display must have approximately mirrored halves. Distinguish equal tails in a symmetric peaked distribution from the absence of a tapering tail in a uniform display.
